title: Build a Company Website With the Agency Theme | Orchard Core
description:
A company website needs sections for its services, projects and team, a menu that leads visitors to them, and a way for visitors to get in touch.

The Agency theme and its setup recipe create a landing page whose Services, Portfolio, About, Team and Clients sections are Bag parts of the Flows module. This video edits those sections, builds a contact form with the Forms module, and adds the form page to the main menu.

In this video:
• The Agency recipe, and the Bag parts behind its sections
• The starting site, section by section
• Editing the landing page: change an item, add a service, reorder cards
• Adding a contact form with the Forms module
• Adding the form page to the main menu with a Content Menu Item
• The finished site
• What you built
